$comment: Hand-curated input for scripts/scrape/items-client.mjs: Classic Era pre-raid best-in-slot lists for the
simulated specs. Every item listed here joins src/data/items/pre-bis.json whatever its quality or level
(it must still be equippable and pass the Season of Discovery id guard), and pool items get
preRaidBis: [{ spec, slot, rank }]. Curated 2026-09-22 (user request: 'If there are some pre-raid BIS
that aren't in our filter they should be included too'); mage lists added 2026-09-24; hunter lists 2026-09-24.
See docs/data/items.md#pre-raid-bis-lists.
Sources (doctrine section 2, Classic Era only): Wowhead's WoW Classic pre-raid BiS guides as archived
in May 2021, before Season of Mastery and before TBC Classic. The same guides on wowhead.com today have
been rewritten for Season of Mastery ('...Pre-Raid Best in Slot Gear list for Protection Warrior Tank in
WoW Classic Season of Mastery'), which the doctrine forbids, so the archived versions are cited.
Wowhead's Classic mage guide has no Fire list, so mage-fire cites Icy Veins' Classic guide, archived
in February 2021 (also before Season of Mastery).
Selection: the guide's order is the rank (1 = BiS, 2+ = alternatives). Each slot keeps the top pick plus
two alternatives; finger and trinket keep four, since two are worn. The guides link Horde PvP items;
the Alliance counterpart is added at the same rank. PvP items are Rank 10 or lower. No raid drops.
An item Forever redesigned out of the spec's role is left out and keeps no rank; the other entries keep
the guide's rank, and the spec's note says why (Diamond Flask, docs/classes/warrior.md Q30).
Random-suffix items are listed by their base id, and the pool has only the base row's stats (no
suffix). One whose base row has no spell stats is left out like a raid drop: the entries below it
move up, and the spec's note names it. One that keeps a rank has the guide's suffix in its notes.
Sim-ranked lists (the three warlocks, 2026-09-24): where no allowed guide fits the spec's default build in
Forever (a build the guide never considered, or items Forever re-itemized past the guide's picks), the sim
ranks pre-raid pool items for it and the guide's picks are among the candidates; the rank is the sim's,
not the guide's, and the spec's note gives the method (docs/data/items.md#pre-raid-bis-lists). Event-only
items (the Scourge Invasion's) aren't candidates.
These are Classic Era lists. Forever re-itemized many of these items and added level-55+ dungeons with
no recorded drops yet, so Forever's real pre-raid BiS will differ. The only Forever BiS lists found on
2026-09-22 were for level 20; replace these lists when a level-60 Forever one exists.

druid-balance.name: Balance Druid

source.title: Classic Balance Druid Best in Slot (BiS) Gear Guide - WoW Classic 1.13 (section: Pre-Raid Best in Slot Gear for Balance Druids - Phase 6)

druid-balance.note: Wowhead had no stand-alone Classic Balance pre-raid guide before Season of Mastery (its balance-druid-dps-pre-raid-best-in-slot-bis-gear-wow-classic page is first archived in December 2021), so this list is the 'Pre-Raid Best in Slot Gear for Balance Druids - Phase 6' section of its Balance BiS gear guide (last modified 2021-05-15). The guide marks two items Best in the waist, ring and trinket rows; they keep the guide's order as ranks 1 and 2. It lists only three trinkets, two belts, two cloaks, two gloves, two legs and two boots, and no idol, so there is no relic row. Its one Weapon table lists the main-hand pair first, then the Rod of the Ogre Magi (Two-Hand), then Witchblade; each slot numbers its own items from 1, and the default takes the main hand and off-hand. The guide names both Arathi Basin exalted daggers, Sageclaw (League of Arathor, Alliance) and Mindfang (The Defilers, Horde), so they share rank 1 and no counterpart was added. It links no PvP rank items and no raid drops. Random-suffix items are listed by their base id, and the pool has only the base row's stats (no suffix). One whose base row has no spell stats is left out like a raid drop, and the entries below it move up: Eternal Crown (head), Eternal Spaulders (shoulder), Archivist Cape (back), Flameweave Cuffs (wrist), Slaghide Gauntlets (hands) and Adventurer's Belt (waist), all of Arcane Wrath in the guide. Abyssal Cloth Amice (of Sorcery) keeps its rank on its base row's spell hit, without the suffix. Diana's Pearl Necklace (22403) carries the client's name, Nacreous Shell Necklace. The Bloodvine set is crafted, but its Tailoring patterns need Zandalar Tribe reputation and its Bloodvine reagent comes from Zul'Gurub.

mage-fire.name: Fire Mage

source.title: Mage DPS Pre-Raid Gear - WoW Classic - Icy Veins

mage-fire.note: Wowhead's Classic guide has no Fire list, so this is Icy Veins' Classic mage pre-raid list, which says it is for Fire mages heading into AQ40 (Phase 5; last updated 2020-12-06); its low-ranked Frost-only swaps fall outside the kept ranks. Its Horde PvP and Arathi Basin gear gets the Alliance counterpart at the same rank. Its Bloodvine set and Flarecore Leggings are crafted, not raid drops, but need Zul'Gurub / Molten Core materials. Its random-suffix items whose base item has no spell stats are left out, so the entries below them move up: Archivist Cape (back); Flameweave Cuffs, Tearfall Bracers, Master's Bracers and Abyssal Cloth Wristbands (wrist); Demon Blade (main hand). Abyssal Cloth Amice and Drakestone are random-suffix too but keep their rank on their base stats, without the guide's suffix. The guide's Diana's Pearl Necklace is 22403, named Nacreous Shell Necklace in the client, and it links Dryad's Wrist Bindings 19597 (the level-49 bracket version), so the level-60 version 19595 is listed instead. Its rank-2 two-hander, Staff of Balzaphon, is event-only: Balzaphon appears in Stratholme only during the Scourge Invasion (docs/data/items.md#sources-c). It keeps the guide's rank, since the default wears a one-hander and an off hand.

warlock-destruction.name: Destruction Warlock

source.title: Classic Warlock Best in Slot (BiS) Pre-Raid Gear Guide - WoW Classic 1.13

warlock-destruction.note: Ranked by the sim, not copied from a guide (docs/data/items.md 'Forever caveat': let the sim decide; docs/classes/warlock.md#73-gear). Wowhead's Classic warlock guide (the source below) has one Shadow list for every warlock, and it never considers the Fire items the default Fire build (warlock.md §7.1) can use. Candidates: every pool item a warlock can wear with spell damage (any school), spell power, spell hit or crit, Intellect or an effect, from pre-raid sources (dungeons, quests, reputation, crafting, world drops, PvP Rank 10 or lower), with the guide's picks among them. Left out: raid drops (Zul'Gurub, Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj); event-only items, from the Scourge Invasion (Chains of the Lich and Staff of Balzaphon, from Balzaphon in Stratholme, and the invasion's other bosses' loot); Forever-new items, whose sources aren't known yet; random-suffix items, whose base rows have no spell stats; and four weapons whose Classic Era sources couldn't be confirmed: Verimonde's Last Resort and Shivsprocket's Shiv (Forever's +74 caster-weapon spell power, a [?] estimate; the sim would rank them second and third in the main hand), Whiteout Staff (it would lead a Horde warlock's two-handers; Ironbark Staff, which a Horde warlock can't wear, leads the Alliance's) and Amethyst War Staff. Method: a slot-by-slot paired search from the old default gear (the default Orc Destruction setup, 6,000 fights a candidate on seed 2701, common random numbers) until no swap helped, then each slot's alternatives ranked by their paired DPS in the finished set (20,000 fights); close calls get a direct paired run (40,000 fights). Within the 95% interval the guide's pick keeps the place (Deathmist Wraps over Inferno Gloves; Eye of the Beast over Rune of the Guard Captain, +0.02 ± 0.15). The Bloodvine Garb 3-piece (+2% spell crit) and the Champion's Dreadgear 2-piece (+23 spell power) win over more Dreadgear (paired, in the finished set: 4 pieces -20 to -31 DPS, 5 pieces -30, 6 pieces -42). Fire items lose most slots: the default build still casts Shadow (Shadowburn, Corruption, Bane of Doom), so +1 Fire spell damage is worth about 70% of +1 to every school (the sim's weights: 0.41 against 0.58 DPS), and Tome of Fiery Arcana's +40 Fire ranks second to Therazane's Touch's +31. The two-hand row's rank 1 is Ironbark Staff, the Alliance's (paired, a Human: -12.9 DPS against Sageclaw and Therazane's Touch; Lord Valthalak's Staff -54.1); a Horde warlock's best two-hander is Lord Valthalak's. Twins at the same rank: the Alliance Dreadweave pieces, Sageclaw for Mindfang, the Arathi Basin and Alterac Valley belts, and the two Blackrock Depths rings.
